rca_of_the_issue.bug_description: All AI features (War Room, Intelligence Hub, Hypothesis, Market Predictions) were failing with 'Failed to execute postMessage on Window: Request object could not be cloned' error
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause_analysis: The error occurred because: (1) authFetch and fetchWithRetry in AuthContext.jsx were using AbortController.signal for request timeout, (2) The service-worker.js had a fetch handler that intercepted all requests, (3) When the service worker tried to clone the Request object to pass it via postMessage, it failed because AbortController.signal is not structured-cloneable (it's a DOM object that cannot be serialized)
reproduction_steps: 2. Navigate to AI War Room or Intelligence Hub
5. Observe error in browser console: 'Failed to execute postMessage on Window: Request object could not be cloned'
fix_applied: 1. Replaced AbortController.signal with Promise.race timeout pattern in authFetch (line 21-24)
2. Replaced AbortController.signal with Promise.race timeout pattern in fetchWithRetry (line 41-44)
3. Removed fetch handler from service-worker.js (now v3 with only install, activate, push, notificationclick handlers)
4. Updated build/service-worker.js to match public version
5. Added reg.update() in App.js to force-update stale service workers
rca_of_the_issue.verification: All 12 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests confirmed no postMessage errors in browser console during AI feature usage.
